[[Bow of the Kinslayer]] is a [[unique item|unique]] [[recurve bow]] obtained from the [[Chest of Burrows]], which appears after killing [[Frostmaw the Kinslayer]], a [[boss]] who can be found in [[Frostmaw's Burrows]].

==Stats==
:[[Piercing damage|Piercing Dmg]]: 15-28 (Requires 9 [[Marksmanship]])
:[[Damage]] +15% (while [[Health]] is above 50%)
:Lengthens [[Poison]] [[duration]] on foes by 33% (Stacking)
:Health +30

==Skin==
This item has the same [[skin]] as a [[Silverwing Recurve Bow]].

==Replica==

**[[Ascalon Recurve Bow]] from collectors [[Bariel Darkroot]] or [[John Verado]]
**[[Recurve Bow]] from collector [[Dye Master Franjek]]

**[[Imperial Recurve Bow]] from collector [[Shen Xi]]
**[[Tormented Recurve Bow]] from collector [[Deacon of Whispers]]

*[[Perfect]] [[Bow Grip]] [[of Fortitude]]

*[[Nundak's Recurve Bow]] has stats identical to this item.
